prs.title: docs: explain residual-five fibers and reproduction evidence
prs.body:
## Why this change is needed

PR119 integrated the exact residual-five predecessor classification and modulo-99 count. Its theorem statements, retained build evidence and reproduction interfaces are spread across the contribution package. A source-specific guide gives readers a pinned account of what was proved and how to inspect or reproduce it.

## What this PR changes

- Adds [ResidualFiveFibersGuide.md](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/056e6e9256ef446b372354c911e2be3d3c006dd1/proofs/ResidualFiveFibersGuide.md): complete ordinary and filtered fibers for every natural parameter, the exact cardinality formulas, and the conditional orbit consequence.
- Separates local coverage at `r = 0` from the bounds `105 ≤ t`, `1 ≤ r` and `t % 6 = 3` derived from an actual family-five occurrence.
- Documents the full 22-module build and the direct current-layout source/import check, including exact prerequisites, output-directory requirements, dependency commits and the historical-wrapper boundary.
- Retains the executed archive-inspection program/output, source-boundary records, full nonauthor reviews and exact earlier documentation versions in the [evidence directory](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/tree/056e6e9256ef446b372354c911e2be3d3c006dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-62/residual-five-guide).

The cumulative delta is **four commits and 17 added paths**, confined to the guide and its Agent #62 evidence directory. Mathematical sources, historical inventories, SOURCE_MAP and other agents' documentation scopes are preserved.

## Validation and review

- **Executed:** bounded in-memory inspection of 143 archive members, all 142 indexed member hashes plus the pinned index, all 25 original command-log hashes and 1,812 original theorem-axiom reports. Complete programs, stdout and exit codes are retained.
- **Inspected, not newly executed:** both repository reproduction commands. The source's retained 22-module Lean build is historical evidence; no new Lean compilation is claimed.
- **Nonauthor reviews:** `/root/final_consistency` checked mathematical wording and evidence consistency; `/root/bounded_link_review` checked the commands, 22-module closure and all 24 current-guide link destinations. Both explicitly used `gpt-6.1-sol` / `ultra` and returned no material blocker within scope. They are separate internal AI-agent reviews under the same account, not external peer review.
- **Publication:** all eight files changed or added by the final commit were fetched and matched completely; the guide's reviewed blob `4124568188c09a0db23617e8a9ff38cf933d7bc8` remains unchanged. Commit parent/tree, current PR head and both complete 17-path deltas were checked.

[Attributed review COMMENT and full-report links](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/pull/157#pullrequestreview-5555094281). Reviewed guide head: `6f191168a6175879276d397a3ce99859c994f982`. Final publication head: `056e6e9256ef446b372354c911e2be3d3c006dd1`.

## Scope and integration

These results classify local predecessor candidates and derive necessary conditions. They do not establish actual candidate reachability, all-time nonpalindromicity of 196, or a decimal Lychrel witness.

Mathematical source baseline: `10a173cb635fa8d03e357f454232816fc3e77609` (PR119). Its complete package-directory and child-tree identities match observed later main `74a1c3922eb7af438fe40b23d2105ad07556e3f5`. Final integration and any required target-branch checks belong to the designated integration owner; no main-write slot or merge is claimed.

Coordination: [issue #61](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/issues/61), task `proofs/coordination/tasks/agent62-residual-five-guide-20261016.json` on `p196/coordination`.
